notes.title: Hexodius Update Released
notes.content:
Hexodius update :

Features :
- Resolution settings added in the Options/Graphics menu.

Bug Fix :
- The game is now launched in windowed mode if unable to launch in full screen mode (no suitable graphics card found error).
- Key binding is now working correctly.
- Generic gamepads are now detected.

tags.feature: - Resolution settings added in the Options/Graphics menu.

tags.bug: - The game is now launched in windowed mode if unable to launch in full screen mode (no suitable graphics card found error).
- Key binding is now working correctly.
